name: Alert
intent: Tells the user about the status of the page or of something they just did: an error to fix, a warning, a success confirmation or neutral information. Stays in the page flow (not a popup). Place it above the content it is about, e.g. at the top of a form or Card.

props.name: severity
props.description: Meaning of the message. Sets color, icon and screen-reader urgency.

props.name: variant
props.description: subtle for inline messages, solid for page-level banners, outline for low emphasis in dense UI.

props.name: title
props.description: Short bold summary above the message.

props.name: children
props.description: The message: what happened and what to do next.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button. Omit for messages that must stay.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replace the severity icon, or false to hide it.

variants.name: subtle
variants.intent: Default inline message inside a page, form or card.

variants.name: solid
variants.intent: High-priority banner at the top of a page.

when: A form failed to submit: severity="danger" at the top of the form, summarising what to fix.
Confirming that something saved or sent: severity="success".
Warning about a consequence before the user acts: severity="warning".

whenNot.situation: An error on one specific field
A decision the user must make before continuing
Temporary confirmation that disappears on its own

composition: One Alert per message; do not stack more than two.
Put the Alert directly above the content it refers to.
Write the message as: what happened, then what to do.

accessibility.role: alert for danger and warning (announced immediately); status for info and success (announced politely)
keyboard: The close button and action are reachable with Tab
notes: Color is never the only signal: each severity has its own icon.
Only render an Alert with role=alert when the problem actually happens, not on page load.

examples.title: Form error
examples.code: <Alert severity="danger" title="We couldn't save your changes">Check the highlighted fields and try again.</Alert>

examples.title: With action
examples.code: <Alert severity="warning" action={<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Renew</Button>}>Your plan ends in 3 days.</Alert>
